Looking back, my journey at SVCE has been nothing short of transformative. It has been a place that nurtured
my aspirations, provided countless opportunities, and shaped me into who I am today.  
From serving as the President of the Coding Club to bringing Google Developer Groups to our college and
building a team of 50+ passionate individuals, every step has been a milestone. I am deeply grateful to Swathi
Ma’am for trusting me with such an incredible opportunity.  
One of the most fulfilling experiences was bringing Google Developer Group to our college, striving to foster a
strong coding culture. I sincerely appreciate the support from our Principal, Sudhakar Reddy Sir, and Swathi
Ma’am, who gave me the freedom to build a team and create a lasting impact.  
         A defining achievement of my journey was Pkelibrary, a chatbot-driven initiative that has delivered over
1 million study materials to 5,000+ students. What started as a simple idea is now evolving into an NGO for
students, a testament to how small initiatives can lead to something much bigger.  
         I am also incredibly grateful for the amazing friends I made along the way. A special thanks to my
Coding Club and Google Developer Group teams, whose passion and dedication turned ideas into reality. The
memories we created together will always hold a special place in my heart.  
“My Message to my juniors ”: 
- Follow your passion, but never forget the sacrifices your parents have made for you.  
- Explore beyond academics—participate in technical and non-technical clubs, as they shape you holistically.  
- Develop a skill that sets you apart—SVCE offers opportunities not just to learn but to earn.  
- Be persistent—your journey may not always be smooth, but resilience will define your success.  
- Cherish your friendships—college is not just about learning; it’s about the people who make the journey                     
     A special thanks to Mohan Reddy Sir, our Placement Cell Head, for his relentless efforts in bringing
companies to our campus, even during tough times. Because of these efforts, I secured an opportunity with
msg global through on-campus placements. 
 
        SVCE has given me some of the best years of my life, and I will always be proud to be an SVCEian.
Our Prominent Graduates

Embracing Growth at SVCE :
Looking back at my time in SVCE, I realize that it was more than just an academic journey—it was a period of
discovery, learning, and transformation. The beautiful green campus, the peaceful environment, and the
vibrant student life created a perfect setting for both personal and professional growth.  
One of the most defining aspects of my journey was the guidance of our teachers, who played a crucial role in
shaping our paths. A special mention to Saritha Ma’am, who introduced me to programming in a way that
made it approachable rather than intimidating. The fear that many students have about coding disappeared
under her guidance, and it turned into a skill I now use every day in my career.   
Beyond the classroom, SVCE provided opportunities to explore new ideas, collaborate with peers, and build
confidence. Whether it was discussions with friends under the shade of campus trees or preparing for
placements with unwavering support from faculty, every moment contributed to the person I am today.
A Few Words to My Juniors
- Don't fear new challenges—what seems tough today will become your strength tomorrow.   
- Take a moment to enjoy the beauty of the campus—it’s a place you’ll always miss after you graduate.
- Believe in yourself—every small project or learning experience adds up to something bigger.    
SVCE has given me memories, knowledge, and friendships that I will carry for life. I hope every student here
finds their own path and makes the most of this incredible journey.

HARIVILLU IS A VIBRANT TRADITIONAL EVENT
CELEBRATED DURING THE SANKRANTI FESTIVAL IN
SOUTH INDIA. THE FESTIVAL IS MARKED BY COLORFUL
KITES SOARING IN THE SKY, SYMBOLIZING JOY AND
PROSPERITY. PEOPLE DRESS IN TRADITIONAL ATTIRE,
WITH WOMEN WEARING BRIGHT SILK SAREES AND MEN
IN DHOTIS, ADDING TO THE FESTIVE SPIRIT. THE EVENT
TAKES PLACE IN OPEN FIELDS OR VILLAGE STREETS,
WHERE FAMILIES GATHER TO CELEBRATE WITH
ENTHUSIASM. THE ENTRANCE TO HOMES AND EVENT
SPACES IS BEAUTIFULLY DECORATED WITH MANGO
LEAVES, SUGARCANE, AND RANGOLI DESIGNS,
ENHANCING THE CULTURAL ESSENCE OF THE
OCCASION.
AS THE DAY UNFOLDS, STUDENTS AND FACULTY
EAGERLY PARTICIPATE IN KITE-FLYING COMPETITIONS,
WHILE ELDERS SHARE FESTIVE SWEETS AND
DELICACIES. THE SKY TRANSFORMS INTO A
MESMERIZING CANVAS OF VIBRANT KITES, CREATING A
BREATHTAKING VIEW AGAINST THE GOLDEN HUES OF
THE SETTING SUN. THE ATMOSPHERE IS FILLED WITH
LAUGHTER, MUSIC, AND TRADITIONAL FOLK
PERFORMANCES, MAKING HARIVILLU A CHERISHED
PART OF THE SANKRANTI FESTIVITIES. THE EVENT NOT
ONLY BRINGS COMMUNITIES TOGETHER BUT ALSO
PRESERVES AND PROMOTES CULTURAL HERITAGE,
MAKING IT A JOYOUS AND UNFORGETTABLE
CELEBRATION.

IEEE - The institute of electrical and electronics engineers is a global professional organization dedicated to advancing
technology for the benefits of humanity. IEEE connects professionals across various fields, fostering collaboration and
setting standards. It offers networking, career development, technical growth, and community engagement. As a
student member, you gain access to scholarships, awards, and events that enhance your skills and support your career
advancement.
The student branch of IEEE-SVCE has demonstrated a keen in rest in forming several societies, such as Signal
Processing Society, Communication Society, Power and Energy Society, Computer Society, Nano Technology Council,
Sensor Council, Women In Engineering.
Computer society:
The IEEE Computer Society is a professional
organization within the broader IEEE community,
focusing on advancing the theory, practice, and
application of computer science and technology.
The mission of the IEEE Computer Society is to
provide technical information, services, and support
to the global computing community. Its goals
include advancing computer science and
technology, as well as offering professional
development and networking opportunities for its
members.
Sensor Council:
The IEEE Sensor Council is a professional
organization under the umbrella of the IEEE,
dedicated to advancing the theory and practice of
sensors and sensing technology across various
disciplines.
The IEEE Sensor Council promotes sensor research,
development, and application for societal benefit. It
fosters collaboration among experts and facilitates
knowledge sharing in sensor technology.
Nano council:
The IEEE Nanotechnology Council (NTC) is a
professional organization within the broader IEEE
community, focused on advancing the theory,
design, fabrication, and application of
nanotechnology.
The IEEE Nanotechnology Council advances
nanotechnology for humanity's benefit. It promotes
interdisciplinary research, collaboration, knowledge
exchange, and professional development.
WIE:
The IEEE Women in Engineering (WIE) is a global
network within the IEEE community, dedicated to
promoting the advancement and inclusion of
women in the fields of engineering and technology.
IEEE Women in Engineering empowers women in
technology by promoting diversity, professional
growth, and leadership opportunities. It fosters a
supportive community, provides mentorship, and
advocates for policies that enhance women's
participation and success in STEM fields globally.

The Smart India Hackathon is an annual event organized by the Indian government to
encourage innovation and problem-solving through technology. It involves teams of
students from various colleges and universities across India competing to develop
innovative solutions to real-world problems faced by different industries and sectors.
Unlocking innovation through technology, the
Smart India Hackathon paves the way for a
brighter, digitally empowered India.
A Program on 'Innovation & Entrepreneurship Outreach Program in
Schools/Community': is organized by Institution's Innovation Council, in association with
Computer Science Engineering department on 16th December 2023. The program is
conducted in Mandal Parishad Primary School Venkatapuram.
The objective of conducting this activity was to motivate the students and young minds
about innovation. The session was presented by the faculty and student coordinators of
the department.
An Innovation and Entrepreneurship Outreach
Program can be a powerful force for economic
development, empowerment, and community
growth. By providing education, mentorship, and
resources, it can equip individuals with the the
skills and confidence they need to tackle real-world
challenges and pursue their entrepreneurial
aspirations.
A total of 40 students from the school attended the
session with full enthusiasm and learned about new
things. Students demonstrated, an. ability to
engage in critical thinking by analyzing situations
and constructing and selecting viable solutions to
solve problems, which will develop an ability
among them to work effectively with other in team.
1. Introduce scientific inquiry and experimental concepts.
2. Develop problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
3. Encourage creativity and hypothesis generation.
4. Provide resources and mentorship for scientific exploration.
5. Foster a culture of collaboration and curiosity-driven
experimentation.
In this session, the coordinators introduced fun and
simple science experiments to primary school students.
They explained how to create exciting projects using
everyday materials and encouraged curiosity through
hands-on activities. The students learned how to explore
science in a creative way while performing experiments
with guidance and enthusiasm.
The Google Developer Student Clubs (DSC) is a program developed by Google for university
students interested in computer science and technology. DSCs are community groups on
college campuses that provide a space for students to learn and collaborate on various
technology-related projects. These clubs offer workshops, study jams, and other events to
help students develop their skills in areas such as web development, mobile app development,
machine learning, and more.
They are typically led by student leads who are passionate about technology and serve as a
bridge between their peers and the broader developer community. Overall, Google DSCs aim to
foster a spirit of innovation and technological exploration among students.

Animal shelters play a very important role in
our society. They provide a safe haven for
homeless animals, help control the animal
population, and offer an opportunity for
people to adopt a new family member. By
volunteering or making a donation, you can
support these shelters and contribute to a
great cause. Remember, every animal
deserves a safe, loving home, and animal
shelters are a big step in making that happen.
